summary: Iteration 15: FCM Firebase key fix VERIFIED. All 9 backend tests passed (100%). The HEARTLINK_FIREBASE_B64 env var successfully overrides the stale FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON injected by K8s. Diagnostics endpoint now returns error='The registration token is not a valid FCM registration token' (correct key + fake token), NOT 'Invalid JWT Signature' (which would indicate old key still in use). firebase_initialized=true, provider=fcm, configured=true, can_send_notifications=true, scheduler_running=true. Both fcm_service.py and firebase_config.py correctly read HEARTLINK_FIREBASE_B64 first with base64 decoding, and fall back to FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON.
critical_code_review_comments: firebase_config.py and fcm_service.py both initialize firebase_admin independently - consolidating to single init module would be cleaner, but current dual-init is safe due to `if not firebase_admin._apps` guard.
PushNotificationRequest uses 'message' field name while FCM diagnostics API and other push APIs use 'body' - inconsistent naming across API surface (minor, not blocking).
seed_data_creation: Registered a fake FCM token on the admin user (review@heartlink.co.in, id=cca39b3f-9f7e-485d-9ae3-d6b210d424fb) to verify diagnostics endpoint. Should be cleared or ignored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: FCM/Firebase key fix is verified working in preview. Key evidence: /api/fcm/diagnostics/{admin_id} returns test_send_result.error='The registration token is not a valid FCM registration token' proving the NEW key is being used (old key would give 'Invalid JWT Signature'). All push/status, push/test, push/send, daily-notification-status endpoints working. When deployed to production, verify the same by hitting /api/admin/push/status and checking a diagnostics call.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: Emergent K8s platform injects FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON env var with an old/invalid service account key. Since Python's load_dotenv defaults to override=False, the .env file's correct key was ignored. Mitigation (applied): Added HEARTLINK_FIREBASE_B64 (base64-encoded JSON) with a custom prefix that K8s does not override. Both fcm_service.py and firebase_config.py now check HEARTLINK_FIREBASE_B64 first (base64 decode) and fall back to FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON. Verified: Firebase initialized with new key, no 'Invalid JWT Signature' errors.
